verdict.rationale: Custom fields and saved list views are a fair axis for a CRM, but the evidence pack never documents ops users adding fields or building filtered, sorted, or shared views. The only related item is community praise for Salesforce's general customizability, which says nothing about self-serve field or view creation without an admin. Another community comment says companies end up relying on consultants, which cuts against the 'no admin project' part of the story.
